_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: the scalar field — a value at every point
the isovalue — the threshold is a surface

voltage.after: the isovalue — the threshold is a surface
voltage.why: the triply-periodic minimal surface has no vertices until the threshold is chosen — the field is the thing that is real; the surface is only a decision about where to cut it.
the SDF is rendered straight to the eye without ever becoming a mesh — sculpting-by-function as anti-mesh, the surface refused, the field kept continuous.

voltage.after: sculpt the field — add and subtract
voltage.why: the cave as queer spatial topology — the walkable interior is a negative shaped by subtraction, space defined by what the field withholds rather than what it asserts.
